## Type of Change

<!-- Check the Conventional Commit type(s) that apply. -->
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or page
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `build`: Build system or dependency change
- [ ] `ci`: Continuous integration change
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, config
- [ ] `style`: Formatting or styling change with no functional impact
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change with no functional impact
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `test`: Test-only change
- [ ] `revert`: Reverts a previous commit

<!-- Use `fix` for hotfixes. -->

- [ ] Added regression and end-to-end tests for this bug fix (required for `fix` and `hotfix` PRs)
- [ ] Tested on mobile viewport
- [ ] Tested in a different browser (e.g., Firefox, Safari)
